# Stacy

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

## Appearance

Miss Stacy is a bright young woman with fair, lovely curly hair and fascinating eyes. She dresses beautifully and wears her sleeve puffs larger than anyone else in Avonlea.

_Sources: [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)_

## Personality

Miss Stacy is a sympathetic, ladylike teacher with a sweet voice who excels at winning the affection of her pupils. She encourages her students to think, explore, and discover for themselves rather than relying solely on beaten paths. She is deeply interested in her students' progress and holds high ideals regarding their mental and moral development.

_Sources: [v1 c21 P12](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0012), [v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001), [v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c31 P13](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0013)_

## Traits

- Sympathetic  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>

- To bring out the best in her pupils mentally and morally  <sub>[v1 c24 P1](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0001)</sub>
- To prepare her Queen's class students to successfully pass their entrance examinations  <sub>[v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P29](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0029), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032)</sub>

## History

Miss Muriel Stacy is engaged as the new schoolteacher in Avonlea, becoming the first woman to hold the position there. She introduces several novel practices, including physical culture exercises, nature study field afternoons, and bi-weekly recitation sessions. In November of her first year, she organizes a Christmas concert to raise money for a schoolhouse flag. Recognizing the potential of her advanced pupils, she forms an extra class after school hours to prepare them for the Queen's Academy entrance examinations. Although offered a position at a school in her home district for the following year, she decides to remain in Avonlea to see her students through their examinations. Her entire class passes the entrance exams successfully, with her pupils Anne Shirley and Gilbert Blythe tying for first place on the island.

_Sources: [v1 c22 P10](../source/v01-c22.md#nw-v01-c22-p0010), [v1 c23 P41](../source/v01-c23.md#nw-v01-c23-p0041), [v1 c24 P6](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0006), [v1 c24 P8](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0008), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P14](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0014), [v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v1 c32 P40](../source/v01-c32.md#nw-v01-c32-p0040)_
